ciFast.note: Fast verification reruns release, format, lint, unit, evaluation, build, and bundle gates after push.

ciDeep.note: Deep proof remains an explicit downstream repository workflow rather than being represented as local browser proof.

deploy.note: Deployment remains downstream of successful repository checks and merge.

liveProvider.note: Real in-app-browser runs cover private Algi and opt-in researched Algi. Algi made no language-model inference; the researched run used the live Wikipedia source path.

manualHuman.note: No instructor, classroom, human-preference, accessibility-certification, or factual-validity claim is made.

manualBrowser.note: A private UX run and researched Environmental Microbiology run were inspected in the workspace. The final ZIP, source receipt, desktop/mobile panels, single download control, Agent state, and browser console were checked.

claims.summary: Algi V0 answers typed course-map and lesson-kernel contracts from uploaded and source-anchored knowledge without model download, inference, or model-only voice rewrites.
Private mode sends no course-topic research request, research is explicit opt-in, and unsupported private lessons remain visible gaps.
Course-aware ranking, entity filtering, aliases, topic families, and integrative composition turn retrieved source passages into mechanically admitted lesson knowledge.
Algi and Scion feed the same CourseIR, compiler, sequence contract, quality gates, Agent evidence layer, and exporters, including reader-facing copy repairs found during inspection.
Genome URL fabrication is blocked, mixed-source provider identity is citation-local, and publisher/URL disagreement cannot receive a trusted source-ledger state.

Private UX reaches 99/A with texture 97 and no topic research; researched Environmental Microbiology reaches 99/A, exports a valid 55-entry ZIP with a correct OpenStax receipt, and passes desktop/mobile/console inspection.
Algi is documented as an evidence engine rather than a universal reasoning model; Gemma weights and adapter state remain unchanged; the hybrid Scion/Algi direction is explicit.

carryForward.item: Forecast private, uploaded-source, and researched lesson coverage before generation.
Measure a compact semantic retriever against held-out paraphrase coverage before accepting its download and memory cost.
Add provider-diverse primary and OER research before encyclopedia fallback.
Evaluate a hybrid Algi evidence to Scion authoring route on one frozen cross-domain benchmark.
